title: Runescape: Dragonwilds, Dragonslayer Any% 36:43
author: RNGDestiny
description:
0.7.2
Seems like they're hotfixing some placements. Goblin quest NPC placement in swamp vault is more noticeable, added a poison plant after blightwood is obtained.

Speedrun notes
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vgcZe29z29d6sQdx8Nnryo7URuQOpmcNPVIXmDEqrSQ/edit?usp=sharing

comments.author: @enhancedcalm
comments.text: It looks like they roughly quadrupled Velgar's health from when this run happened. It takes 4 times longer to get his health down each quarter with iron dagger. They didn't make any patch notes on it, but it takes way longer to kill him now. Took about 60 hits to kill him, around 15 swings per quarter here. Now it takes about 60 swings per quarter of his health, and I had the damage combo unlocked.

comments.author: @anoobis117
comments.text: Can't wait to see you speedrun the 1.0 release

comments.author: @Haitatchi
comments.text:
Chopping the bloodwood sap with all the garou standing around was hilarious.
I guess a perfect/fully optimized run sub 35 is possible but that's roughly the limit.
With two players, you should be able to go sub 30 but first you'll have to clone yourself.

comments.author: @ouijhg1
comments.text: amazing run gj man. So quick you didnt even need to sleep

comments.author: @gormenbros_talon5061
comments.text: Very cool Run!!         Can I ask if there is any tech to how quickly you pick up the wood at the begining, I tried to replicate on both Mouse and Key and Controller, I feel like it might be a FPS issue or something on my end. This is my 1st "gathering/ Building game" I have been interersted in running.

comments.author: @RNGDestiny
comments.text: I don't have much more advice than spam the e button and practice. But some things to be aware of, it takes a moment for the game to register that the item is clickable, maybe it's better with higher fps but mine usually tanks during that section because of how much I'm swinging the camera around. And some logs/stones are further in the ground which decreases the radius you can aim at to pick up, mostly the logs near the pond and the stones in the rubble textures, I don't notice it too much in the path I took here.
